source: NTSB aviation downloadable datasets and CAROL

official_public_evidence.artifact: NTSB legacy AV data directory / eadmspub schema timestamp
official_public_evidence.establishes: The NTSB legacy public AV-data directory lists the eADMS public schema with a 2010 timestamp, demonstrating that a documented downloadable aviation-data distribution surface predated CAROL.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: record-level contents or availability dates for any individual accident record

official_public_evidence.artifact: NTSB legacy AV data directory / AVALL.ZIP timestamp
official_public_evidence.establishes: The official legacy directory lists AVALL.ZIP with a 2012-06-01 timestamp, proving that AVALL was publicly distributed by that date.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: that every record or modern field currently present in AVALL was contained in the 2012 snapshot because preserved bytes have not been acquired

official_public_evidence.artifact: NTSB press release announcing CAROL public-facing database
official_public_evidence.establishes: CAROL was publicly launched by this date; aviation investigations since 2008 were described as available, subject to noted multi-aircraft migration caveats.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: field-level contents of each aviation record at this date

official_public_evidence.artifact: NTSB press release on expanded CAROL/Aviation Investigation Search
official_public_evidence.establishes: Expanded aviation search from 1962-present and CSV/JSON download capabilities with additional fields were publicly announced by this date.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: that fields added by the expansion existed in earlier public releases

official_public_evidence.establishes: A dated schema/data release checkpoint and documented adjustment of thousands of records.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: original public availability of the revised historical values

official_public_evidence.establishes: The findings table added cm_inPC in monthly/weekly AVALL downloads and the field was back-filled for historical records.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: cm_inPC as a historically public field before 2024-03-01; back-filled values must not leak into earlier cutoffs

official_public_evidence.artifact: ICPSR/DataLumos Census of US Civil Aviation Accidents V1 / avall.zip
official_public_evidence.publisher_attribution: National Transportation Safety Board; ICPSR/DataLumos distributor
official_public_evidence.establishes: A versioned public deposit preserves avall.zip bytes with a 2025-04-21 publication/version context and file-level timestamp. Once the exact bytes/hash are acquired and inspected, record/field values present in this snapshot can support verified PIT for cutoffs on or after this anchor date.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: availability of those values before 2025-04-21, or contents of earlier AVALL snapshots

official_public_evidence.establishes: The current avall.zip snapshot is dated 2026-09-01 and the directory describes AVALL as a downloadable public aviation dataset; monthly and weekly update files are also present.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: the content or publication date of earlier snapshots no longer present in the directory

release_semantics.avall: aviation data from 2008-present, updated monthly according to NTSB release notes
release_semantics.weekly_updates: aviation data update packages are described as updated weekly
release_semantics.release_notes: document schema/data changes but may include back-fills and corrections to older records
release_semantics.carol_dynamic_search: current CAROL queries reflect current database state and are not historical snapshots

pit_implications: The 2010/2012 legacy-directory timestamps prove source-level public distribution before CAROL but do not make every present-day historical record PIT-admissible.
The 2025-04-21 DataLumos deposit is a strong versioned snapshot anchor; exact record/field verification still requires acquiring and hashing the preserved bytes.
A release date can bound when a schema/field became publicly available but does not prove every record value existed at that release.
Back-filled or corrected historical values inherit the later release evidence unless an earlier snapshot proves the value existed earlier.
Current CAROL/AVALL presence must not be back-projected before the earliest evidenced release containing that field/value.
For strict backtests, official report/publication artifacts or archived dataset snapshots remain preferable to administrative timestamps stored in the current database.
coverage_gap: The accessible evidence now includes a versioned 2025 AVALL snapshot anchor plus source/schema bounds back to 2010/2012, but not a retained sequence of record-level AVALL snapshots covering historical cutoffs across 2010-2025. Additional archived snapshots or record-specific official publication evidence are required for broad field-level PIT verification.
